headline: Getting help when you need it—we're here for your learning journey
universal_truth: Asking for help is a strength, not a weakness; support systems exist to be used
fun_facts: Most questions have already been answered in our FAQ—check there first for instant help
Our support team responds within 24 hours—usually much faster
Community members often have great insights too—the commons is full of wisdom
discussion_questions: What's stopping you from asking for help when you need it?
How do you prefer to get support—self-service or human contact?
What would make your learning experience easier?

hook.script: Stuck? Confused? Something not working? Getting help is easy, and we want you to ask. This lesson shows you exactly how to get the support you need, when you need it.

cliff.script: Many people struggle in silence instead of asking for help. Why is reaching out actually the smart move?

options.text: Asking for help saves time and frustration—struggling alone when answers exist wastes energy; we've designed multiple support channels precisely because we want you to use them
options.response: Exactly. We built these support systems to be used. Your time and energy matter. Reach out—we're genuinely happy to help.

options.text: I should figure it out myself
options.response: Independence is valuable, but so is efficiency. Using support wisely is a skill, not a weakness...

fact1.title: Self-Service Options
fact1.script: For quick answers, start with our FAQ and help articles. Most common questions are answered there. Search by keyword or browse categories. Instant answers, no waiting required.

fact2.title: Contact Support
fact2.script: Need personal help? Email hello@curiouskelly.com. Describe your issue clearly, include your account email, and we'll respond within 24 hours—usually faster. Real humans read every message.

fact3.title: Community Wisdom
fact3.script: The Commons—our community space—is full of learners who've faced similar challenges. Browse discussions, ask questions, share experiences. Often the best help comes from fellow travelers.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Asking for help isn't failure—it's efficiency. We're genuinely here to support your learning. Use us.

outro.script: That's your support guide. Bookmark this lesson for future reference. And remember: hello@curiouskelly.com is always here for you.

growTrack.title: Support Bookmark - Know Where to Go
growTrack.activity: Bookmark the FAQ page and save hello@curiouskelly.com in your contacts. When you need help, you'll know exactly where to go.
